message: Close <html> explicitly: add </html> at the end of the file.
Close <body> explicitly: add </body> at the end of the file.
<section> has no heading; give it one (h2–h6), or name it with aria-labelledby. A <section> that is only a styling hook isn’t a section; use data-layout on its parent instead.
<section> is never closed: it runs to the end of the file. Add </section> where it should end.
